hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'gh pr create'; then pr_url=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_result.stdout // ""' | grep -oE 'https://github.com/[^ ]+' | head -1); pr_num=$(echo "$pr_url" | grep -oE '[0-9]+$'); if [ -n "$pr_num" ]; then echo "{\"decision\": \"approve\", \"reason\": \"PR created\", \"systemMessage\": \"PR #${pr_num} created. Launch the code-reviewer agent to review it: use the code-reviewer agent with prompt 'Review PR #${pr_num}' and post findings as a GitHub comment.\"}"; else echo '{"decision": "approve"}'; fi; else echo '{"decision": "approve"}'; fi
